turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I'm feeling a bit groggy, but okay, I guess. Still waking up.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That's normal. Can you tell me your pain level on a scale of 1 to 10?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Maybe around 4? There's some discomfort in my tummy, but not too bad.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Alright, we'll manage that with some medication. Are you feeling nauseous at all?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: A little, but not throwing up or anything. Just a bit of a queasy feeling.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Okay, we'll keep an eye on that. How's your breathing? Any tightness or discomfort?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, breathing's fine. My throat's a bit sore, but I can breathe okay.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That soreness is from the LMA tube. It should ease soon. Any memory of the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I don't remember anything. I was out completely.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. Given your BMI and hyperlipidemia, we'll monitor your vitals closely. Any chest pain or shortness of breath?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, nothing like that. Just tired and a bit sore.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Alright, rest well. We'll check on you regularly and get you mobilized soon.
